summary.headline: Pisces Birth Prognoses
summary.text: Astrological physiognomic and prognostic descriptions for boys and girls born under Pisces, covering character, travel, marriage, injuries, illnesses, lifespan, bodily marks, and remedies invoking Saint George and Saint Gregory.
